name: Sado (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sado city emblem in yellow and light blue: a yellow stylised island shape above a light blue wave.
history: Municipal flag of Sado, a city in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 March 2004.
